name: hephi-superagent-plugin
description: HEPHI code delivery domain plugin for DeepSeek Super Agent

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.test:unit: vitest run tests/contracts tests/control/activation.test.ts tests/control/decision-log.test.ts tests/control/plugin-version.test.ts tests/control/ready-gate.test.ts tests/tools
scripts.test:integration: vitest run tests/control tests/probes tests/kb tests/verification tests/eval --exclude tests/control/activation.test.ts --exclude tests/control/decision-log.test.ts --exclude tests/control/plugin-version.test.ts --exclude tests/control/ready-gate.test.ts
